basics.name: Federico Failla
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer · Java / Backend
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years of experience building backend and full-stack applications with Java 8–17 and Spring Boot across banking, tax administration, gaming, and online booking domains. Recent work focuses on microservices, REST APIs, and cross-functional delivery with Product, QA and BI teams. Hands-on with application implementation and deployment using GitLab, Azure DevOps, Docker and Rancher, PostgreSQL-backed services, and React/TypeScript interfaces.
